generator: HelioSI paper-to-skill factory (wave500 PFSS / coronal source mapping batch, +45)
harness_framing: RUNTIME-NEUTRAL. Paper-skills do not assume a specific harness or agent framework. LingTai / Claude Code / Codex appear only as example adapters in Layer 3. .library/custom/pfss-tracing/ and .library/custom/nspf-fem/ are example bindings, not requirements, and are NOT modified by this batch.
scope: PFSS / NSPF / source mapping / coronal magnetic extrapolation / solar wind source regions / magnetograms / open flux. Selected from sioulas-reproduction/results/arxiv_papers/theme_pfss_modeling.json (and adjacent) and confirmed disjoint from the existing 96-object corpus.

skill_md_structure.model: Each SKILL.md is organized as four explicit layers so the same compiled paper is loadable by any runtime.

layers.layer_1_scientific_invariant: Narrow-form claim, method/data assumptions, failure modes (skill memory), figure / numerical targets, claim boundary.
layers.layer_2_executable_protocol: Capability-typed procedure naming abstract capabilities (e.g. pfss.solve, magnetogram.fetch_synoptic_br) — never a specific MCP / framework. Validation target sits here.
layers.layer_3_adapter_notes: Optional examples of concrete bindings in one runtime. Examples only; not requirements.
layers.layer_4_research_generation_affordances: Gaps, tensions, new hypotheses, composable experiments enabled by combining this paper-skill with siblings.

skill_md_structure.mcp_policy: No MCP is asserted to exist. Capabilities in Layer 2 are abstract names; specific bindings (MCPs, libraries, scripts) are runtime-supplied and live in Layer 3 only as illustration.
